meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 安装后 Claude 多出两个工具:列出 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里当前可用的本地模型,以及把提示发给指定模型并取回回答。Claude 仍是调度方,可把部分工作交给本地运行的模型。
howto.when: 当你要求用 Atomic Chat 或本地模型来回答任务时会接管,例如说「用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都」。前提是 Atomic Chat 桌面应用已安装、本地 API 服务已在 1337 端口开启。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: Claude 先列出模型,再用其中一个生成回答。

say.text: 用 atomic_chat_generate 让本地模型回答:什么是 MCP?
say.note: 模型 ID 需与列表返回的完全一致。

say.text: 先用 atomic_chat_list_models 看看本地有哪些模型
say.note: 列出 Atomic Chat 中当前可用的模型。

howto.what_en: Claude gains two tools: list models available in the Atomic Chat desktop app, and send a prompt to a chosen model and return its reply. Claude stays the orchestrator and can offload work to local models served locally by Atomic Chat.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to use Atomic Chat or a local model to answer something. Requires the Atomic Chat desktop app installed with its Local API Server enabled on port 1337.

say_en.text: use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude lists models, then generates with one.

say_en.text: use atomic_chat_generate to answer: what is MCP?
say_en.note: The model ID must match the listed IDs.

say_en.text: use atomic_chat_list_models to see which local models exist
say_en.note: Lists the models currently available in Atomic Chat.
